app.name: CheckMyDrive
app.tagline: Know if a used drive is safe before you trust it.

nav.mockBanner: Demo mode: showing sample drives. Nothing on your computer is being tested.

picker.title: Which drive do you want to check?
picker.subtitle: Plug in the drive you are thinking of buying or using, then pick it below. The check takes about 3 to 4 minutes.
picker.empty: No drives found. Plug one in and press Refresh.
picker.systemDiskHint: Your computer runs from this drive. It can be checked in safe mode only.
picker.loadFailed: We could not read the list of drives.
picker.noAdminNote: Some details such as health data may need administrator permission and will be requested when the check starts.

mode.title: How thorough should the check be?

safe.title: Quick safe test (keeps your files)
safe.desc: Reads the whole drive and writes a small temporary file, so nothing you own is changed or lost.

wipe.title: Full wipe test (most thorough, ERASES everything)
wipe.desc: Also writes across the entire drive to catch fake capacity and hidden defects. Every file on the drive is permanently destroyed.
wipe.dangerBody: This permanently deletes ALL data on {{model}}. It cannot be undone. Only continue if the drive is empty or you have a backup.
wipe.confirmLabel: To confirm, type the drive's serial number: {{serial}}
wipe.noSerial: This drive does not report a serial number, so a full wipe test is not available.
wipe.systemBlocked: Your system disk can never be wiped. Only the safe test is available.
wipe.mismatch: The text does not match the serial number yet.

mode.duration: Takes about 3 to 4 minutes. Please do not unplug the drive.

running.title: Checking your drive
running.subtitle: Please keep the drive plugged in and the computer awake.
running.cancelConfirm: Stop the test? Nothing on your drive was changed in safe mode.
running.adminPrompt: Your computer may ask for your password. This lets CheckMyDrive read the drive directly.

drive_info.name: Drive identity
drive_info.desc: Model, size and type of drive

smart_health.name: Health report
smart_health.desc: The drive's own record of problems and wear

surface_read.name: Surface scan
surface_read.desc: Reads spots across the whole drive

write_verify.name: Write and verify
write_verify.desc: Saves data and reads it back

capacity_check.name: Real capacity
capacity_check.desc: Makes sure the size is not fake

results.title: Results

summary.buy: This {{model}} looks healthy. We found no serious problems and it should be fine for everyday use.
summary.caution: This {{model}} works, but we found some warning signs. Only use it for files you can afford to lose, or negotiate a lower price.
summary.avoid: Do not trust this {{model}}. We found serious problems that put your files at risk.
summary.fake_capacity: This {{model}} is lying about its size. It claims {{claimed}} but cannot actually store that much. Do not buy or use it.
summary.failing: This {{model}} is failing. Its own health data and our tests show it can lose your files at any time.

can.title: Can I…
can.os: Install an operating system on it?
can.fillNo: We would not store anything important on it.

age.title: Age of the drive
age.yearsLessThanOne: Less than a year of use
age.unknown: This drive does not report how long it has been used.
age.note: Hours are counted only while the drive is powered on. A drive used 24/7 ages faster than one used a few hours a day.

results.skippedNote: Fake-capacity detection was not run. Use the full wipe test on an empty drive for a complete answer.

settings.title: Settings and about
settings.languageHint: Languages other than English are loaded as they become available; missing text appears in English.
settings.disclaimer: CheckMyDrive gives an educated estimate and cannot guarantee a drive will never fail. Always keep backups of files that matter.

issue.unknown: Something unusual was found ({{code}}). See the test matrix for details.

age.high_hours: This drive has been powered on for about {{years}} years ({{hours}} hours), which is a lot of use.
age.moderate_hours: This drive has been powered on for about {{years}} years ({{hours}} hours).

drive_info.model_unknown: The drive did not report its model name.
drive_info.system_disk: This is the disk your computer runs from. Only the safe, non-destructive test was run.

smart.overall_failed: The drive's own health check says it is failing.

smart.pending_sectors: {{count}} areas of the drive are unreadable and waiting to be replaced.
smart.uncorrectable_sectors: {{count}} areas of the drive could not be read or corrected.
smart.crc_errors: {{count}} data-transfer errors were recorded, often caused by a bad cable or connector.
smart.error_log_entries: The drive's error log contains {{count}} entries.
smart.ssd_worn: This SSD has used up about {{percent}}% of its rated lifetime.

smart.nvme_critical_warning: The drive is reporting a critical warning (code {{value}}).
smart.nvme_media_errors: The drive's memory has logged {{count}} data-integrity errors.
smart.spare_low: Only {{percent}}% of the drive's spare memory is left.

selftest.not_supported: This drive does not support the quick self-test.

capacity_check.fake_capacity: This drive claims to hold {{claimed_bytes}} bytes but only about {{real_bytes}} bytes are real. It is a fake-capacity drive.
capacity_check.io_error: The drive returned {{count}} errors during the capacity check.

stability.device_disconnected: The drive disappeared {{count}} time(s) during the tests.
stability.io_errors: The drive returned {{count}} read or write errors during the tests.
stability.timeouts: The drive timed out {{count}} time(s) during the tests.
stability.crc_errors_increased: Data-transfer errors increased by {{count}} during the tests. Check the cable.

os_install.caution: It may work, but there is some risk. Keep a backup.

long_term_storage.ok: Good for storing files long term.

daily_use.caution: Usable for everyday files, but keep backups.

error.title: The check could not finish
error.refused: The test was refused for safety. Wipe tests cannot run on the system disk or without a matching serial number.
error.engine_missing: The checking tool was not found. Please reinstall CheckMyDrive.
error.auth_cancelled: Permission was not granted, so the drive was not checked.
error.elevation_unavailable: Could not ask for administrator permission on this computer.
error.bad_args: The test could not start because of an internal request error.
error.needs_admin: Administrator permission is needed to test this drive.
error.drive_not_found: That drive could not be found. It may have been unplugged.
error.system_disk_refused: This is the disk your computer runs from, so it cannot be erased. Choose another drive.
error.confirm_required: Please confirm the drive's serial number before a full test that erases data.
error.confirm_mismatch: The serial number you entered does not match this drive. Nothing was changed.
error.cannot_open_device: The drive could not be opened for testing. Another program may be using it.
error.unmount_failed: The drive's volumes could not be safely disconnected before the full test. Close any programs using it and try again.
error.internal: Something unexpected went wrong inside the test engine.
